name: Sketch Pad
description: A minimal example of the canvas panel type.
long_description: Demonstrates the canvas ui.type. getData()'s return value is not drawn -- strokes come from the user drawing -- but its color/width fields set the pen used for the next stroke; this plugin sources those from config_schema so they are configurable per workspace. onAction can replace the canvas contents by returning a new strokes array; the Undo button uses that to drop the most recent stroke.
author: dia
